text: [203] pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadora 2 assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantevava saṅkhaṃ gacchati katamehi pañcahi ājjavena javena maddavena khantiyā soraccena imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadora 3 assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantevava saṅkhaṃ gacchati . evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa katamehi pañcahi ājjavena javena maddavena khantiyā soraccena imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti .
